fusions.name: Worry the Throat
fusions.desc: A weapon strike on an enemy at or below 25% health that deals 24 damage, makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pack Leap
fusions.desc: You leap up to 6 tiles to your target and deal 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles of where you land. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Pick Them Clean
fusions.desc: Removes one condition from you and from every ally near you.

fusions.name: Hound Host
fusions.desc: A bonded hound fights beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds within 4 tiles and making its target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each kill you make restores 4 health.
